reason: The dust is falling into the young disk, so the disk is the natural place to begin.

reason: The gas-rich band is where solids collect, so it is the natural place to gather the shattered grains.

reaction: The compatibility feedback clarified the route.

reaction: It is satisfying to see the fragments become gravity-bound bodies.
reason: The fast stones crossing the young bodies suggest the next collision in the path toward gathering a world from shattered pieces.

expectation: Some fragments will gather onto the small body to make a little world.

reaction: It was satisfying to see shattered material become a world without being fused into solid rock.

mostWorthwhile.text: Gathering the fragments into a rubble world brought the collision and rebuilding sequence together clearly.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the shattered grains directly at the gas-rich band was a premature step; compatibility feedback supplied the missing intermediate.

surprise.text: The broken grains needed another gentle encounter to become compact pebbles before gathering in the band.

arbitrary.text: The need for the slower grain supply was not obvious to me before the feedback, though the explanation of gentle collisions made its purpose clear afterward.

continue.text: Yes. The sequence made the physical processes understandable, and the new world's path toward a larger growing body leaves me curious what happens next.
